investigation.root_cause: Unhandled authentication exception in middleware pipeline

fix.explanation: Implements token refresh fallback handler with idempotency guard to prevent infinite retry loops. When a 401 authentication error occurs, the middleware checks if a retry has already been attempted. If not, it marks the request with a _retry flag, refreshes the session, and replays the request exactly once. This prevents unhandled authentication exceptions from propagating while avoiding cascading retry failures.

outputs.explanation: Implements a token refresh fallback handler to gracefully manage authentication exceptions in the middleware pipeline. The patch adds: (1) a try-catch wrapper around token verification, (2) automatic token refresh attempt on expiration, (3) fallback to re-authentication if refresh fails, and (4) proper error logging and user feedback. This prevents unhandled exceptions from crashing the pipeline.
